svg.desc: A five-by-five attention grid for the tokens 'the cat sat on mat'. Cells on and below the diagonal are allowed; cells above are masked with minus infinity. The row for 'sat' has weights 0.2, 0.5, 0.3 over 'the', 'cat', 'sat'. Beside it, the four steps: scaled scores QK transpose over root d, add the causal mask, softmax each row, multiply by V.

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Causal self-attention as a soft lookup

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Each query scores every key, the mask hides the future, softmax turns scores into weights.
